integrity: Original-claim assessment based on comparison to cited public literature and finite independently computed examples. The general result rests on the explicit analytical spectral decomposition. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-size independent-fibre blow-ups only; arbitrary simple undirected base graphs; adjacency-Hamiltonian uniform long-time Cesàro average only.
The full spectrum is expressed in terms of the base average-mixing spectrum and diagonal of its zero-adjacency projector.
No characterization of instantaneous mixing, sampling-dependent mixing or unequal-size fibres.
A distinct primary source already gives the spectral idempotents of graph blow-ups; this contribution is their Schur-square average-mixing diagonalization and rank/gap interpretation.
title: Spectral gap and exact quantum average-mixing rank for graph blow-ups
